```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(sf)
terraOptions(progress = 0)
```

```{r}
red_raw <- rast("data/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1_SR_B4.tif")

nir_raw <- rast("data/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1_SR_B5.tif")

swir1_raw <- rast("data/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1_SR_B6.tif")

thermal_raw <- rast("data/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1_ST_B10.tif")

cities <- st_read("data/California_Cities_and_Identifiers_Blue_Version_view_-3024944392275494958/California_City_Boundaries_and_Identifiers.shp")
```


```{r}

#removes the raster cells exhibiting reflectance values outside of USGS's
#acceptable range. ifel is just terra's version of ifsele
red_raw <- ifel(red_raw < 7273 | red_raw > 43636, NA, red_raw)
nir_raw <- ifel(nir_raw < 7273 | nir_raw > 43636, NA, nir_raw)
swir1_raw <- ifel(swir1_raw < 7273 | swir1_raw > 43636, NA, swir1_raw)

#scales rasters according to USGS standards
red <- red_raw * 0.0000275 - 0.2
nir <- nir_raw * 0.0000275 - 0.2
swir1 <- swir1_raw * 0.0000275 - 0.2

#band math to create NDVI and NDBI indicies
NDVI <- (nir - red) / (nir + red)
NDBI <- (swir1 - nir) / (swir1 + nir)

#scales the thermal raster to celsius
LST_kelvin <- (thermal_raw * 0.00341802 + 149)
LST <- (LST_kelvin - 273.15)

#stacks the rasters so I can modify them all at the same time
landsat_stack <- c(NDVI, NDBI, LST)
names(landsat_stack) <- c("NDVI", "NDBI", "LST")
plot(landsat_stack)

chico <- cities %>%
  filter(CDTFA_CITY == "Chico") %>%
  select("GNIS_ID")

#reproject the city's shapefile to align with the raster stack
chico_reproject <- vect(chico)
chico_reproject <- project(chico_reproject, crs(landsat_stack))

#crops and masks the raster so it fits within the Chico boundary
landsat_chico <- crop(landsat_stack, chico_reproject)
landsat_chico <- mask(landsat_chico, chico_reproject)

landsat_chico_df <- as.data.frame(landsat_chico, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
glimpse(landsat_chico_df)

summary(landsat_chico_df)

#plots each of the rasters
plot(
  landsat_chico,
  fun = function() {
    lines(chico_reproject)
  }
)
```
